summary: Full backend + frontend test of Emergent Cybersecurity AI Gateway. 12/13 backend tests pass (92%). Login redirect verified working (the main agent's concern is resolved). All dashboard pages render, all 7 agents listed, sidebar nav works, ERROR log filter works, Health page shows mongo/llm, chat input exists. One backend test fails (502 via Kubernetes ingress on long code-agent response — direct localhost backend works, so it's an ingress 60s timeout, not a code bug).

minor.issue: Returns 502 via public preview URL when LLM response is long (>~60s). Direct backend localhost:8001 call succeeds. Likely Kubernetes ingress timeout. Consider streaming response or shorter system prompt for code agent to keep responses under 60s.

integration_issues.issue: Playwright submitted 'Explain CVE-2024-3094' and waited 25s, but main pane still showed '// READY' placeholder. Session count did not increase. May be that the Playwright selector 'button[type=submit]' hit a non-send button OR chat message bubbles aren't rendering. Worth a manual re-verification by main agent.
affected_selectors: chat send button likely missing data-testid='chat-send'

action_items: Add data-testid='chat-send' and data-testid='chat-input' on Console.jsx send button and textarea so frontend automation can reliably trigger chat submission and verify message rendering.

Investigate ingress 502 on long code-agent responses — either (a) stream responses, (b) shorten code-agent system prompt to cap response under ~55s, or (c) document the limitation. Backend itself is healthy.
Optionally add data-testid attributes on nav links and on log filter buttons for stable testing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event hooks; consider lifespan handler in future.
safety_check uses substring match — 'attack the' could over-match benign content; acceptable for MVP but worth widening with regex word boundaries.
Orchestrator inserts user_msg then mutates it with $set; uses dict(user_msg) copy correctly. Good.
Mongo _id properly excluded via projection or pop(). Good.
Frontend api.js correctly uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — no hardcoding.
Login.jsx has proper form onSubmit + e.preventDefault — login redirect works as verified.

success_rate.frontend: 85% (login + all pages render; chat-submit interaction needs data-testid)

test_credentials: Bearer token: emergent-cyber-token-2026 (from /app/backend/.env). /app/memory/test_credentials.md is currently empty — main agent should populate it.
seed_data_creation: Test created several sessions/messages (TEST_summary report, Explain CVE-2024-3094, osint, port scanner). Visible in Sessions list. Safe to leave or cleanup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend gateway is solid. The 502 on '/api/orchestrator/chat' for code-agent prompts is ingress timeout, not backend bug — verified via direct localhost call. Login submits + navigates to / correctly. Chat send selectors need data-testid for reliable Playwright validation of message rendering.
rca_of_the_issue: Original concern from main agent ('login fill/click did not navigate') — could not reproduce. Playwright fill of [data-testid=login-token-input] + click [data-testid=login-submit-button] navigated /login → / consistently. Likely main agent's earlier attempt used wrong selector or stale localStorage. Code (Login.jsx) is correct: onSubmit handler calls login(token), setToken, then nav('/').
